2) Compliance Enterprise: Dedicated capacity + Audit logs (365d) + BYOK/HSM + Data residency + expanded SLAs — intended for production HIPAA workloads.

Hi all — quick technical addendum to Priya's note (keeps pricing + ops constraints aligned):

- KMS/HSM options:
  * Managed KMS (Redwood-managed keys): minimal integration work, key rotation handled by Redwood. No one-time integration fee; included in Enterprise bundle.
  * Customer-managed KMS (BYOK) with HSM-backed keys: requires an integration window (2-4 weeks), an initial validation run, and a monthly HSM support fee (we price at $4,500/mo as Priya noted). We also charge a one-time set-up validation of $6,000 if you require on-prem HSM guardrails.

- Audit logs and retention: logs are stored compressed and billed by ingest (GB/month). Typical mid-sized healthcare customer sees ~15–30 GB/month depending on telemetry level. Retention tiers: 30/90/365 with deltas to cost as Priya listed; export to customer S3 for long-term archival is supported (additional egress/replication fees apply).

- Data residency and private deployments:
  * Hosted single-region: compliant controls in-region; no surcharge.
  * Multi-region (active-active): +12% subscription uplift; needed if you require cross-region failover with residency constraints.
  * Private VPC deployment (customer-managed infra): estimated lead time 4–6 weeks; on-prem appliance: 6–10 weeks depending on procurement of hardware. Professional services estimates are provided separately.

- HIPAA specifics: our BAA covers data handling, breach reporting obligations, and controls matrix. For high-risk workflows we recommend the Enterprise package (it includes SOC2 plus extended logging and forensics retention).

Attaching a small CSV with audit log price breakouts (audit_logs_pricing.csv). Happy to run a quick sizing call if you can share expected monthly request & token volumes.

—Monica
